    Galaxy Buds4 Pro

    See the impression that's being made

    • Winner of EISA In-Ear Headphones
      2026-2027 Award

    • "The Galaxy Buds4 Pro are extremely recommendable. I absolutely love the sound quality in them. The fit and the comfort are incredible. The microphones are really, really impressive. And they have pretty much every feature I would want. These are not only a jack of all trades, but also a master of quite a few as well."

      Mike O'Brien

    • "Your music will sound fuller with more delicate and precise high tones and an impactful (but not overwhelming) bassline rounding out your scores."

      TechRadar, 02/2026

    • "The Galaxy Buds4 Pro deliver a warm sound that's tuned for the mainstream: bass is ample, without being overpowering, vocals are clean, and the high-end gives a great impression of detail. Tool's Parabola hits hard on the chorus, but I was still able to pick out individual instruments."

      Stuff

      Introducing Galaxy Buds4 Pro — the all-new definition of Hi-Fi audio. Crafted with a new metal blade design and all-day ergonomic comfort, Galaxy Buds4 Pro delivers sound true to the original through an advanced 2-way Speaker that's powered by a wider woofer, Dual Amplifier and seamless 24-bit / 96 kHz codec. Enhanced Active Noise Cancellation instantly immerses you in your music, while Super Clear Call ensures crystal-clear conversations with advanced DNN technology. The upgraded One UI streamlines connections across your Galaxy devices, keeping the entire Galaxy ecosystem in sync. Just ask AI agents like Bixby when you need help. Hear every detail in every note with Galaxy Buds4 Pro.23, 24

      MEET THE TRUE HI-FI GALAXY BUDS

      Advanced 2-way Speaker

      From deeper, richer lows powered by a wider woofer to clear highs, the advanced 2-way Speaker delivers a complete, balanced sound.

      Design

      Iconic in metal, shaped for all-day comfort. The real metal blade defines both design and control. Ergonomic contours create a secure, natural fit that stays comfortable from morning to night.

      Ultra High Quality Audio

      Ultra High Quality Audio with 24-bit / 96 kHz reveals every layer, making the world feel richer and more alive.

      Super Clear Call

      Your voice is captured clearly by advanced machine-learned DNN, even in noisy moments, and delivered pure and effortless through Super Wideband.

      Charging Case

      From clean, sculptural form to smooth magnetic docking, the Charging Case turns everyday use into a refined experience.

      Iconic metal design.
      Built for all-day
      comfort

      The real metal blade defines both design and control. Finely sculpted from aluminium and perfected to create an impeccable hairline, Galaxy Buds4 Pro shines elegantly, turning heads. Finished in timeless colours, it presents a classic look that feels sophisticated yet versatile. Shaped for lasting comfort and stability, the surface that touches your ears feel naturally comfortable to provide a secure fit. From docking and charging to control, every interaction flows seamlessly through an ergonomic design.

      DESIGN

      Unveil the artistry of
      full-spectrum Hi-Fi sound

      ADVANCED 2-WAY SPEAKER

      Hi-Fi sound.
      Hear the full range

      Meet the true Hi-Fi Galaxy Buds. The advanced 2-way Speaker paired with dedicated Dual Amp is meticulously tuned to achieve high-fidelity sound across the full spectrum. Bring the studio-scale listening system to your ears, wherever you are.

      • 2-way Speaker

        Two separate drivers — the newly designed wider woofer with an expanded diaphragm area, and a precision tweeter — are expertly aligned to reproduce sound that remains faithful to the original recording. The advanced 2-way Speaker delivers a full-range performance, from deep, textured sub-bass to airy, extended highs, while preserving natural bass resonance with faster transient response, a rich midrange body and sharp detail.

      • Dual Amplifier

        Each amplifier on Galaxy Buds4 Pro is dedicated to its own driver, expanding sound coverage while reducing distortion and interference through meticulous tuning. The result is a high-fidelity soundscape that immerses you in the full spectrum of sound.

        ADVANCED WIRELESS AUDIO

        Hear every layer come alive

        Hear every layer come alive with extended bit depth and high sampling rates. Samsung Seamless Codec (SSC) supports 24-bit / 96 kHz audio to preserve the original sound with vast amount of information, while optimised data transmission control enables a stable listening experience with reduced audible artefacts or dropouts. Turn on the Ultra High Quality Audio (UHQ) option on your Galaxy smartphone and rediscover your favourite songs in full detail., ,

        24-bit / 96 kHz
        Samsung Seamless Codec - UHQ

        ADAPTIVE EQUALISER

        Tailor Hi-Fi sound your way

        Take a step closer to the ultimate in audio. Customise bass, treble and tone with the 9-Band Equaliser to match your preference, creating a sound signature tailored just for you. Galaxy Buds4 Pro also optimises sound adaptively to your ear shape and wearing style, ensuring a consistent listening experience as your ears perceive it — even when you adjust the volume.

        SUPER CLEAR CALL

        Super Clear Call, even in noise

        Even your calls are clear like Hi-Fi audio. Your voice is clearly captured by 6 microphones positioned around your head, intelligently isolating it from the background sound with advanced Deep Neural Network (DNN). The exceptionally clean voice signal is transmitted with pure effortlessness through Super Wideband (SWB) up to 16 kHz between your Galaxy Buds4 Pro and Galaxy smartphone. Hear and be heard, loud and clear — even in noisy moments., ,

        Two Galaxy smartphones are on each side with a pair of white, Galaxy Buds4 Pro in the middle. Between the earbuds is a phone call icon. The smartphone on the left shows the call screen with the name 'Ava' and the smartphone on the right shows the call screen with the name 'Sam'. In the background are multiple waves showcasing the Super Clear Call feature available on Galaxy Buds4 Pro.

        360 AUDIO

        Surround yourself in sound

        Expand your soundstage from stereo into a grand orchestral hall or a large arena, placing you at the centre of a live performance with a single touch. Feel every instrument and vocals in three dimensions, surrounding you with natural depth and spacious clarity. You don't just hear the music — you're enveloped by the atmosphere all around you.

        A man sitting on a couch as a collection of instruments appear in a circle around him. The instruments include a mic with a mic stand, a drum set, trumpet, cello, violin, electric guitar and grand piano. The instruments are shown in outline, highlighting the 360 Audio system available on Galaxy Buds4 Pro.

        How to get the most out of your Hi-Fi sound Galaxy Buds4 Pro next to a Galaxy smartphone, explaining how to pair and experience full-spectrum Hi-Fi sound. Galaxy Bud4 Pro Charging Case opens and a pop-up appears on the screen of the Galaxy smartphone. "Connect" is tapped to pair the devices. The first section explains how to get the right fit with a single Galaxy Buds4 Pro earbud placed in an ear canal, moving slightly up and down to demonstrate a comfortable fit. The next section explains how to check the fit by opening the Quick Panel and tapping the Settings icon on the Galaxy smartphone. Then, selecting "Christina's Buds4 Pro", "Sound quality and effects", "Earbud fit test" and "Start" to begin. A short test sound plays and a “Keep your earbuds in” notification appears while the fit test runs. The results indicate whether the fit is good or poor. The next section introduces advanced sound settings. In the earbuds settings menu, tap "Sound quality and effects", "Advanced quality options" and toggle on "Ultra high quality (UHQ) audio" for Hi-Fi sound. For clearer calls, toggle on "Super wide band speech". To tailor your sound, tap "Equaliser" on the "Sound quality and effects" menu, select '"Custom" and manually adjust according to your personal preferences. Toggle on "360 audio" to experience surround sound or switch between "Active noise cancelling", "Adaptive" and "Ambient sound" modes. In the final scene, a Galaxy smartphone between a pair of Galaxy Buds4 Pro spins around as circular ripples appear in the background, representing sound waves. The video ends with the Galaxy smartphone tilted on its side, showing the rear cameras, and Galaxy Buds4 Pro floating slightly above the smartphone, with the left earbud slightly higher than the right.

        Deeper immersion that adapts with you

        ENHANCED ANC

        Let Hi-Fi sound stay vivid

        With its top-notch high-fidelity sound system, Galaxy Buds4 Pro achieves precise noise control. Distractions fade in real-time as the Active Noise Cancelling (ANC) algorithm instantly processes and adapts to your ear shape and fit. Listen to vivid, layered and deeply engaging Hi-Fi sound wherever you are.

        ADAPTIVE NOISE CONTROL

        Stay immersed, stay connected

        Manage your listening experience your way. Galaxy Buds4 Pro adjusts the levels of ANC and ambient sounds in real-time, adapting to your environment — whether you're sensitive to noise or prefer more blending.               • Single pinch: Pinch once to play or pause the track, answer or end a call and stop using features such as Read notifications aloud, Voice Detect and Siren Detect.
              • Double pinch: Pinch twice to play the next track.
              • Triple pinch: Pinch three times to play the previous track.
              • Pinch and hold: Pinch and hold to turn on the preset feature or decline a call.
              • Swipe: Swipe up or down using your index finger to adjust the volume.

            • Galaxy Buds4 Pro has two speaker drivers that handle different frequency ranges — the wider woofer and the tweeter. The advanced 2-way Speaker delivers sound across the full-spectrum with more detail and less distortion.

            • Galaxy Buds4 Pro has two dedicated amplifiers for each speaker driver in the advanced 2-way Speaker for intricate control, minimizing interference. This separate operation makes meticulous tuning possible to produce high-quality sound.

            • You can turn on SSC - UHQ option when Galaxy Buds4 Series is paired with an eligible Galaxy device. The audio is delivered in extended 24-bit bit depth and 96 kHz sampling rate. Hear Hi-Fi sound in full detail, with rich audio information.,
